title: Observer health ready does not mean the spectator is watching
description: Golden replay currently treats the observer as ready once the health endpoint reports the table/process is up, but that does not guarantee the spectator has attached to the actual game. While reproducing the failing `golden` CI job from PR #1112, `savannah_lions_blocker_ids` started replay before the observer had begun watching; the observer joined mid-combat, requested hand permissions from both players, and both bridges then sat in `passPriority` until the replay timed out. Evidence from the local repro: `tmp/golden-spectator/spectator.log` showed `keepAlive: auto-watching table` / `Watching game` after the game had already advanced into combat damage, and `tmp/golden-bridge/bridge-events.jsonl` showed `STATUS: spectator has joined`, `STATUS: has started watching`, and `USER_REQUEST_DIALOG` immediately before callbacks stopped. `savannah_lions_trade` and `stack_resolved` then failed as fallout after the hung game. The harness should wait for an authoritative "spectator is actively watching this game" signal before replay starts.
